Kruger National Park – South Africa 🇿🇦

Spanning 19,623 km² (7,576 sq mi) across the northeastern provinces of Limpopo and Mpumalanga, Kruger National Park is one of Africa’s largest and most renowned wildlife sanctuaries. Stretching 360 km from north to south and 65 km from east to west, it offers an expansive natural haven for countless species.

The park’s administrative hub is located in Skukuza. Its protection dates back to 1898, when the government of the South African Republic first set aside land for conservation. In 1926, it was officially proclaimed South Africa’s first national park.
